verdict.rationale: Expensify is a SaaS platform with a public Integration Server API, so agent-readable docs or an llms.txt file are a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack shows no llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation, and a probe for a markdown version of the API docs returned HTTP 404. The `/agent-device` skill in the App repo is a contributor tool for driving simulators during testing, not agent-facing product docs, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
